help.build:
usage: code-review-graph build [-h] [--repo REPO] [-q] [--skip-flows] [--skip-postprocess]

                               [--embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress output
  --skip-flows          Skip flow/community detection (signatures + FTS only)
  --skip-postprocess    Skip all post-processing (raw parse only)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory to store graph database (useful for network shares)
  --embedding-provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}
                        Explicitly refresh an existing embedding index with this provider;
                        requires --embedding-model (default: disabled)
  --embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL
                        Exact model for --embedding-provider. Cloud providers may transmit source-
                        derived text and incur API cost

help.dead-code:
usage: code-review-graph dead-code [-h] [--kind {Function,Class}] [--file-pattern FILE_PATTERN]
                                   [--limit LIMIT] [--json] [--repo REPO] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --kind {Function,Class}
                        Filter by node kind
  --file-pattern FILE_PATTERN
                        Filter by file path substring
  --limit LIMIT         Maximum rows to print (0 = no limit)
  --json                Output a machine-readable JSON array
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory containing the graph database
help.detect-changes:
usage: code-review-graph detect-changes [-h] [--base BASE] [--brief] [--repo REPO] [--churn]
                                        [--verify]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  Git diff base (default: HEAD~1)
  --brief      Show the risk summary + Token Savings panel instead of the full JSON. Read-only
               against the existing graph.
  --repo REPO  Repository root (auto-detected)
  --churn      Add an opt-in change-frequency term to risk scores. Counts commits per file over 90
               days by default; set CRG_CHURN_WINDOW_DAYS to adjust.
  --verify     Calibrate the estimated savings against tiktoken's cl100k_base tokenizer (the GPT-4
               family tokenizer). Adds a second row to the panel with the real token counts.
               Requires `pip install tiktoken`.

help.serve:
usage: code-review-graph serve [-h] [--repo REPO] [--auto-watch] [--tools TOOLS] [--http]
                               [--host ADDR] [--port PORT]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO    Repository root (auto-detected)
  --auto-watch   Start filesystem watch in a daemon thread while MCP server runs
  --tools TOOLS  Comma-separated list of tool names to expose (e.g.
                 query_graph_tool,semantic_search_nodes_tool). Unlisted tools are removed. Falls
                 back to CRG_TOOLS env var. When unset, all tools are available.
  --http         Listen for MCP over Streamable HTTP on localhost (default port 5555)
  --host ADDR    Bind address for --http (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port PORT    Port for --http (default: 5555)

help.update:
usage: code-review-graph update [-h] [--base BASE] [--repo REPO] [-q] [--skip-flows]
                                [--skip-postprocess] [--brief] [--verify] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
                                [--embedding-provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}]
                                [--embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base BASE           Git diff base (default: the commit the graph was last built at)
  --repo REPO           Repository root (auto-detected)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress output
  --skip-flows          Skip flow/community detection (signatures + FTS only)
  --skip-postprocess    Skip all post-processing (raw parse only)
  --brief               After re-parsing changed files into the graph, also print the risk summary
                        + Token Savings panel that 'detect-changes --brief' prints. Use this after
                        a rebase or large change set when you want to refresh the graph AND see
                        the impact in one command; use 'detect-changes --brief' alone when the
                        graph is already up to date (analysis only, no re-parse).
  --verify              Calibrate the estimated savings against tiktoken's cl100k_base tokenizer
                        (the GPT-4 family tokenizer). Adds a second row to the panel with the real
                        token counts. Requires `pip install tiktoken`.
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   External directory to store graph database (useful for network shares)
  --embedding-provider {local,openai,google,minimax,voyage}
                        Explicitly refresh an existing embedding index with this provider;
                        requires --embedding-model (default: disabled)
  --embedding-model EMBEDDING_MODEL
                        Exact model for --embedding-provider. Cloud providers may transmit source-
                        derived text and incur API cost
